verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const die=m=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const r=f=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const mig=fs.readdirSync("supabase/migrations").filter(f=>f.endsWith(".sql")).map(f=>r("supabase/migrations/"+f)).join("\n");if(!/alter table public\.partner_offers\s+add column if not exists visits_required smallint/.test(mig))die("a partner offer cannot carry a loyalty rule");const os=r("app/(main)/partners/listing/offers-section.tsx");if(!/label="Loyalty card"/.test(os))die("a Business has no way to set a loyalty rule");const o=r("lib/partners/offers.ts");if(!/export function loyaltyProgress\(/.test(o))die("nothing counts a member visits toward a card");const a=r("app/(main)/partners/[slug]/loyalty-actions.ts");if(!/export async function claimLoyaltyReward\(/.test(a)||!/source: .loyalty./.test(a)||!/progress\?\.earned/.test(a))die("a member cannot claim an earned card in person, or can claim one not earned");const pg=r("app/(main)/partners/[slug]/page.tsx");if(!/<LoyaltyStamps/.test(pg))die("the member never sees their stamps");const t=r("lib/partners/offers.test.ts");if(!/counts visits since the last claim of this card/.test(t)||!/is never credited by a plaque tap/.test(t))die("nothing measures the visit count or keeps a tap from claiming the card")'

append.detail: A Business sets a loyalty card on a listing offer (partner_offers.visits_required, 2 to 50 visits; migration 20270346002600). Each plaque tap on the existing capture path is a visit (once a day on a repeatable plaque, LIVE-654); the partner page shows the member's stamps, and once full the member claims it at the counter (claimLoyaltyReward logs a partner_redemptions row with source loyalty and the count starts again). No cash. The plaque's repeatable rule is set by the operator in /admin/qr.
